sources.title: Visitors

sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa requirements for travel to Grenada are based on your country of citizenship.

sources.title: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's currently linked Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024 and lists Barbados as not requiring a visa.

sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Jordan Tourism Board nationality table expressly maps Barbados to an applicable 40-JOD visa on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Barbados | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

sources.title: Barbados and Liberia Sign Historic Visa Waiver Agreement
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade, Barbados
sources.officialityEvidence: Barbados' current Foreign Affairs site lists the 18 March 2026 announcement and describes the jointly signed agreement as eliminating visa requirements for Barbadian leisure travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreement eliminates visa requirements for Barbadian nationals traveling to Liberia for business or leisure.

policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Barbados as not requiring a visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Barbadian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table states that Barbadian visitors can obtain a 40-JOD visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Barbadian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Tourism Board table says all non-Jordanians must register for a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry-point, admission and non-visitor categories remain governed by Jordanian authorities.

policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Liberia visa-free business or leisure travel
policies.summary: Barbados' Foreign Affairs Ministry states that the 18 March 2026 Barbados-Liberia agreement eliminates visa requirements for Barbadian business or leisure travel.
conditions: Applies to a Barbadian ordinary passport holder travelling for the business or leisure purposes stated in the announcement.
The source describes the jointly signed agreement as eliminating visa requirements, but does not publish a common maximum stay or separate instrument-of-entry details.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Barbados' 18 March 2026 Foreign Affairs announcement says the signed Barbados-Liberia agreement eliminates visa requirements for Barbadian business or leisure travel.
